carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge extending from the mid-right flank toward the caudal peduncle, defined by a high-contrast gradient with high luminance on the dorsal aspect and deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge of the second dorsal fin exhibits irregular notches and loss of marginal integrity; an elongated dark silhouette is visible on the ventral-lateral flank, consistent with an attached organism.
other_distinctive_markers: Scattered high-luminance circular spots are present on the anterior portion of the upper caudal fin lobe.
